Hi Samantha — thanks for the screenshot and for catching this.

Quick context: we generate a claim link that includes a small RelayState-like token in the query string (for redirecting back to the correct tenant). Some mail clients (Apple Mail on iOS/macOS in particular) will line-wrap or trim trailing padding characters on long query strings when you use the forward action, which can corrupt base64-ish tokens. That matches what your screenshot shows — the forwarded URL is truncated.

Immediate options:
- I'll resend a one-click claim that uses a shorter token (short-lived) which avoids the padding.
- If that still fails, I can create a "manual accept" link that opens a short landing with a pasteable code your AP team can enter.

Ben/Jordan — can you confirm the minimal-change resend (short token) and whether we should also generate a paste-code fallback? If we escalate to product we'll want an action to normalize/ignore trailing whitespace in RelayState parsing.

I'll hold off on doing anything until I hear from you so we don't generate multiple claims for the same vendor.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Ops — Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Coupa invite — accept button blank after forward

Grace / Jordan — digging in. Repro steps from our side:
1) Create claim link with token param `rs` that is URL-safe base64 with padding (example ends with '=').
2) Forward the original invite through Apple Mail (iOS 16 / macOS Monterey) -> forwarded body truncates trailing '=' or collapses spaces around '=' on some clients.
3) Redirector validates token length and fails; shows empty acceptance page because tenant lookup fails early.

Workaround options:
- Shorten token and avoid '=' padding (switch to URL-safe base62-ish short id) -> low-lift and safe for this vendor.
- Implement parsing tolerance: trim whitespace and restore missing padding if the token looks base64-like (we can add a fallback in the redirector).
- Generate pasteable claim code: a 6-8 char code shown on a landing page which AP can type in.

I'll attach a tiny sample of the RelayState-like token and a local test vector. For urgency, I recommend resending with the short token and also issuing the paste-code fallback if Caldera's AP is still blocked.

Attachments: relaystate-sample.txt

- Ben
